why_ai: Desk-based claim adjudication is largely rule execution, though licensed adjusters own coverage and reserve calls.
why_clarity: Examiners handle 150-200 similar claims monthly under SLAs, but reserve accuracy emerges only at closure.
why_digital: Medical records, policies and claim files are processed on screen for remote carrier clients.

why_ai: Most claims follow deterministic paths a rules engine pays without human review.
why_clarity: A claim validates, prices and pays correctly against plan rules or it fails instantly.
why_digital: Electronic claims in, payments and EOBs out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Clients pay for independent review of their administrator, though file testing itself automates.
why_clarity: Files are tested against handling standards, but reserve adequacy is a judgment call.
why_digital: Claim files are reviewed remotely and findings delivered as reports.

why_ai: Fraudsters adapt, and cross-carrier link data is a moat, though scoring itself is ML.
why_clarity: Fraud scores are defined, but confirmation needs investigations that take months.
why_digital: Contributed claim data is scored and linked entirely in software.

why_ai: In-product benchmarking and workflow analytics are software that AI-native platforms replicate.
why_clarity: SLA and reserve metrics are standard and reported on fixed cycles.
why_digital: Claim data across clients is analysed and shipped inside software.

why_ai: Physician-authored guidelines adopted into state regulation are hard for AI outputs to displace.
why_clarity: Evidence synthesis follows method, but whether a duration norm is right shows only across populations.
why_digital: Evidence and claims data synthesised into published digital guidelines.

why_ai: Eligibility and adjudication against plan documents are deterministic once plans are structured.
why_clarity: Claims adjudicate correctly against the SPD or not, across huge volumes.
why_digital: Plan documents, eligibility files and claims are processed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Low-literacy members need trusted guidance, but multilingual AI will cover much of the service.
why_clarity: Enrollment and claims are standard, though member communication varies by language and literacy.
why_digital: Paper enrollment and phone service for staffing agencies, moving to digital channels.

why_ai: Repricing bills against fee schedules and contracts is deterministic rule application.
why_clarity: Each bill reprices exactly to the fee schedule, across millions of bills.
why_digital: Medical bills in, repriced bills and savings reports out, all digital.

why_ai: Procurement rules, union agreements and long relationships slow automation of public benefits work.
why_clarity: Benefit rules are codified in CBAs, but each entity's rules span decades of exceptions.
why_digital: Records-based administration bought through public procurement and local relationships.

why_ai: Licensed nurses coordinate care with physicians and injured workers, sometimes in person.
why_clarity: Return-to-work is measurable, but each injury and worker requires a different plan.
why_digital: Records and phone calls dominate, with some field nurse visits to appointments.

why_ai: Filings follow strict formats and deterministic rules that compliance pipelines automate.
why_clarity: Each filing has a fixed format and deadline and is accepted or rejected.
why_digital: Claims data extracted and filed electronically with regulators.

why_ai: Standard claims processing automates, with local broker relationships the main human element.
why_clarity: Small-group administration follows the same plan rules as larger groups.
why_digital: Paper EOBs and phone calls, sold through local brokers.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries must sign statutory reserve opinions and carry the professional liability.
why_clarity: Opinions follow actuarial standards, but projections are tested only as claims emerge over years.
why_digital: Loss data in, signed reserve opinions and studies out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Analytics automate, but plan design and stop-loss decisions involve employer risk tolerance judgments.
why_clarity: Trend and stop-loss analyses are clear, but plan design outcomes show over years.
why_digital: Claims data analysed and reported to CFOs and risk managers on screen.

why_ai: Statutory adjudicators decide disputes and approve settlements with legal authority.
why_clarity: Procedures are codified, but dispute outcomes are contested and appealed.
why_digital: Filings are digital, but hearings occur in person under exclusive state jurisdiction.

why_ai: Employers hire a trusted adviser to run selection and negotiate, though bid comparison automates.
why_clarity: Selection processes follow standard RFP steps, but TPA performance shows after contract start.
why_digital: Bids and fee data compared on screen, sold through adviser relationships.

why_ai: Reserve and duration prediction over millions of claims is exactly what ML performs.
why_clarity: Reserve development and cost containment are measured, though closure takes years.
why_digital: Claim files are modelled and reported entirely in software.

why_ai: Real-time formulary adjudication automates, but clinical pharmacist interventions on opioids carry licensure.
why_clarity: Formulary rules apply at point of sale on high-volume prescriptions with instant decisions.
why_digital: Prescriptions adjudicated electronically and analysed as data.

why_ai: Licensed adjusters manage medical authorisation, indemnity and fraud judgments under state regulation.
why_clarity: State workflows give clear decision trees, but claim duration and cost emerge slowly.
why_digital: Claims, medical records and payments handled on screen for remote clients.

why_ai: Statutory rating organisations hold the complete loss record and file rates regulators require.
why_clarity: Experience mods and loss costs are computed by published formulas each cycle.
why_digital: Unit statistical data in, loss costs and mods published electronically.

why_ai: Legislators rely on the institute's neutral credibility, though the analysis itself automates.
why_clarity: Interstate comparisons use stated methods, but policy effects take years to show.
why_digital: Contributed claim data analysed into published studies.
